findings.evidence: Lines 99–103 name the Mathlib lemmas and their instantiation; lines 109–125 define the two `@[simp]` wrappers. The docstring text was written for the revision in which those wrappers were deleted (reply 3740662824).

findings.issue: The `cohomologyZeroEquiv` docstring is stale and describes proof plumbing: it says naturality "is Mathlib's `Sheaf.H.equiv₀_naturality` ... applied to `isTerminalTop` and `(SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).map f`", i.e. it directs the reader to instantiate the Mathlib lemma, even though this file now exports `cohomologyZeroEquiv_naturality` (line 111) and `cohomologyZeroEquiv_symm_naturality` (line 120) stating exactly those squares in the file's own vocabulary.

findings.evidence: `grep -n cohomologyMap TauCeti/AlgebraicGeometry/Cohomology/Basic.lean` returns nothing; the file is 133 lines; the sole `instance` is at line 70.
findings.fix: Update the description to the API actually shipped: `Cohomology`, `functorH` + its `Additive` instance, `cohomologyEquivOfIso` (+ apply/symm_apply), `cohomologyZeroEquiv` (+ the two naturality lemmas).
findings.issue: The PR description misdescribes the head. It advertises "induced additive maps with identity/composition/addition laws" (no `cohomologyMap` and no `_id`/`_comp`/`_add` lemmas exist in the file), says "the only categorical instance added records that abelian sheaves ... form a Grothendieck abelian category" (the only instance added is `(functorH X i).Additive` at line 70; the Grothendieck/`HasExt` instances come from the imported Mathlib file), and gives the file as 183 lines when it is 133.

summary: Every declaration is documented, but the module docstring states the H⁰ result with the wrong notation, and the `cohomologyZeroEquiv` docstring is stale: it tells readers to instantiate Mathlib's naturality lemmas themselves while the file now proves those lemmas immediately below. The PR description also describes an API the head does not contain.
